- [R1] Added 'l' format specifier for letters-only matching (added to parse.py)

- [R3] Parser brace validation - implemented in `__init__` (raises ValueError)

- [R10] Result slice access - implemented `__getitem__` to handle slices

All requirements (R1 through R10) have been implemented and existing tests pass. No further changes are needed.
